releases.title: You Will Fall
releases.summary: A parkour climbing game where gravity is your enemy, fire is your only friend, and the ground keeps winning. No checkpoints. No mercy. Just you and your poor life choices.

releases.title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
releases.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the Dragon Quest series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

releases.title: Akashic Slingshot
releases.summary: Fight your way through a diverse world in this action-adventure side scroller, where you are given one weapon and die in one hit. Can you earn the right to peer beyond the Zeroed Abyss?

releases.title: Attack on Titan 3
releases.summary: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.
